title: Panel row measure undercounts draw by 3 — bottom drop-log rows can never be scrolled into view
evidence:
rows := i32(2) // header: title + global line
rows += 2      // drops
rows += 2      // crisis root causes
— but draw_noc_panel emits THREE rows for each: line 446 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, hash, NOC_INK_SOFT)` (3rd header row), line 459 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, ratio_line, NOC_INK_DIM)` (3rd drops row), line 470 `cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, pool_line, NOC_INK_DIM)` (3rd crisis row). Clamp: `scroll := clamp(scroll_in, 0, max(0, total - visible))`
detail: Violates the code's own invariant comment "MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row" and briefing scope item 5 ("Last-N drop log … scrollable"): max scroll is 3 rows short, so when the panel overflows (~61 rows > 50 visible) the last 3 rows (drop-log tail) are unreachable.
recommended_fix: In noc_panel_rows change the header/drops/crisis counts from 2/2/2 to 3/3/3 so the measure matches draw_noc_panel row-for-row.

title: run-dev.sh's documented --stats-out pass-through forwards app flags to odin build, not the app
evidence:
line 15: `# tools/run-dev.sh --stats-out

# pass-through (the app's telemetry flag)` — but line 34: `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}" 2>&1 | head -20` passes ARGS to the compiler, while lines 38/41 (`PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev` / `./bin/app-dev`) receive nothing.
detail: The header documents app-flag pass-through (the app's `--stats-out` telemetry flag), but the arguments land on `odin build`, which rejects unknown flags — the documented usage cannot work. Spec code map names `--stats-out` an app arg pattern.
recommended_fix: Move "${ARGS[@]+}" from the odin build line onto both ./bin/app-dev invocations so runtime flags reach the app.

title: NOC panel forks draw_panel_card inline with drifted alpha values instead of reusing it
evidence: noc_overlay.odin:438-439: `rl.DrawRectangle(NOC_PANEL_X - 8, NOC_PANEL_Y - 10, NOC_PANEL_W + 16, NOC_PANEL_H + 20, rl.Color{255, 252, 244, 230})` / `rl.DrawRectangleLines(..., rl.Color{51, 65, 79, 60})` — vs forecast.odin:117 `draw_panel_card :: proc(v: ^View, x, y, w, h: i32) { card := rl.Color{255, 252, 244, 235} ... border := rl.Color{51, 65, 79, 40}`.
detail: Spec Always-constraint: "SHARE, never fork: reuse `draw_text_c` / `draw_panel_card`". The panel duplicates the shared card chrome inline and the copy already drifted (fill alpha 230 vs 235, border 60 vs 40); its own comment claims "the shared light card (draw_panel_card)".
recommended_fix: Replace the two inline DrawRectangle calls with draw_panel_card(v, NOC_PANEL_X-8, NOC_PANEL_Y-10, NOC_PANEL_W+16, NOC_PANEL_H+20).

title: overlay-check .t1 sidecar byte-matches goldens only for pause-free demos at full-length capture
evidence: overlay.odin:87-89: `if paused_at(cfg.pauses[:], w, hz) { free_all(context.temp_allocator); continue // a paused wall tick steps nothing }` — no hash appended — while the golden driver run.odin:406 appends on paused wall ticks: `append(&hashes, pp.state_hash(&state, state.events[before:], cat, context.temp_allocator))`. Also line 80: `wall_max := min(u64(max(0, i64(cap_ms) * i64(hz) / 1000)), total_wall)`.
detail: AC3 says the emitted stream "is byte-identical to goldens/<demo>.t1". Verified: qos_contention at 12000ms cmp-equal (rc=0), but the pause demo yields 1810 vs 2000 hashes (cmp fails, paused wall ticks unrecorded) and the shipped 10000ms capture is a 200-hash prefix of the 240-hash golden.
recommended_fix: Append the stable-state hash on paused wall ticks (mirror run.odin) and document that the cmp proof requires a capture window covering the demo's full length.
